mission: Signal Loom Runtime Confinement, Live FAIR Risk & Kernel Containment

contract.note: Every entry declares an evidence_state. 'measured' requires a provenance command that reproduces the figure; 'unavailable' requires a reason and MUST carry no figure. sla_ceiling_ms and internal_target_ms are declared REQUIREMENTS -- a threshold is a decision, legitimately authorable -- and are never themselves observations.
contract.history: v1.0.0 of this file was an authored benchmark with no producer: p50/p90/p95/p99 ladders for two latencies, flood_rate_pps 100000 / dropped_pps 100000 / drop_rate 1.0, retention_rate 1.0, parity_rate 1.0, every status PASS, a fixed timestamp. The percentile ladders were the tell -- a distribution cannot be authored. scripts/demo-crkc-mission.sh 'verified' it with [ -f ... ], and scripts/verify-demo-reproducibility.sh asserted its typed literals against its own typed thresholds, which is an assertion that cannot fail. Both are fixed; test/demo-mission-honesty.bats is the guard.

tier0_killswitch_freeze_latency.reason: requires a live cgroup v2 freezer acting on a running agent workload, sampled enough times to support a quantile. No cluster is in scope for the offline demonstration. The one local delegate, test/bench-redteam-stress.sh, derives its per-cycle figure from a modulo of a python loop's duration and then hardcodes its p95 outright, so it is not a source for this field.

live_fair_risk_calculation_latency.reason: the SLA is written against the in-cluster policy-engine FAIR endpoint, which the offline demonstration does not exercise. scripts/demo-crkc-mission.sh does time the real riskctl Monte Carlo and prints that wall clock, but it is a different measurement -- a 200k-iteration in-process simulation including process start -- and is deliberately not recorded here as if it satisfied this threshold.

tc_classifier_drop_throughput.reason: requires a tc clsact qdisc attached to a real veth and a generated flood whose offered and dropped rates are both counted. No dataplane is in scope here. The former drop_rate of exactly 1.0 against an offered rate of exactly 100000 pps was authored, not counted.

flux_drift_ignore_label_retention.reason: requires N observed Flux reconcile cycles against a live cluster with the label applied and re-read after each. bin/policy-compiler proves the invariant manifest is well-formed, which is a different claim and not a substitute.

demo_toggle_parity.reason: requires the route sweep to actually run against both demo and live mode and compare renders. The former parity_rate of 1.0 over 52 routes was authored; the live route inventory has since moved, so even the denominator was stale.
